name: Digital Services (Others)
description: A system that has digital services.
landingBlurb: Digital Service (also known as Government Digital Service) refers to any public service that is delivered digitally. It is used to convey the Government’s position, provide information, and/or deliver services to the public. Digital Services (Others) refer to Digital services with less than 1 million visits per year (note: this will be determined based on WOGAA statistics).
